rationale: Exclude the Apollo Global Management census holding because it is realized, not currently owned. Capital Dynamics' primary transaction release states that on December 29, 2020 its Clean Energy Infrastructure business completed the acquisition of Apollo Funds' remaining 69.98% interest in Arlington Valley Solar Energy II and assumed 100% ownership. A California Public Utilities Commission filing independently identifies Apollo's indirect holding entity and the December 2020 transfer to a Capital Dynamics affiliate. The original 2018 Apollo census URL was reopened but now returns HTTP 404. No subsequent Apollo reacquisition was found. Because no production company or evaluated seed entry exists and this task only concerns Apollo's current portfolio, no company, seed, ownership, redirect, or publication mutation is authorized.
